description: This file provides helper functions for managing context information related to cellular management in an RBUS (Rule-Based Universal Bus) environment. It includes functions to initialize and release context, convert paths, get and set row contexts, and handle dynamic table synchronization. It defines structures and function prototypes to facilitate path translation, context retrieval, and management of table rows and parameters.

methods.name: Context_Init
methods.description: Initializes the context helper API, managing reference counting and ensuring safe repeated calls.

methods.name: Context_Release
methods.description: Releases the context helpers, should be called once for each Context_Init call.

methods.name: ConvertPath
methods.description: Converts a row alias-containing path to a path with only instance numbers.

methods.name: GetParentContext
methods.description: Retrieves the row context for a parameter inside a row.

methods.name: GetRowContext
methods.description: Gets the context of a specific row.

methods.name: SetRowContext
methods.description: Sets the context for a newly created row, including its table name, instance number, and alias.

methods.name: RemoveRowContextByInstNum
methods.description: Removes the context of a row based on its table name and instance number.

methods.name: RemoveRowContextByName
methods.description: Removes the context of a row based on its full name.

methods.name: IsTimeToSyncDynamicTable
methods.description: Determines if it is appropriate to synchronize handlers for a dynamic table at this time.

methods.name: GetParamName
methods.description: Retrieves the leaf parameter name from a full path.

methods.name: GetHandlerContext
methods.description: Provides a handler context for a given element name, including full name, leaf name, and user data.

ctags.name: name
ctags.pattern: /^    char const* name;       \/*leaf name of element*\/$/
